The [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']] had a '''first officer''' leading up to the [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|mission]] to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

During the vessel's stop at [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]] during the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Subjugation of Ralltiir|subjugation]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the [[Officer/Legends|officer]] monitored [[Tion (Lord)/Legends|Lord Tion's]] surveillance system from aboard the vessel, under the orders of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Raymus Antilles/Legends|Antilles]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The first officer appears in the [[Star Wars (radio)|''Star Wars'' radio drama]], aired by NPR in [[1981]].
